label: Demo, not an evaluation
class_prompt:
This is a satellite image crop centred on one building after a disaster.
What is the damage level of the building in the centre?
Answer with one word: Intact, Damaged or Destroyed.
inspection_prompt:
You are a structural engineer examining a satellite image crop centred on Building #<id>.
Describe the building's condition and grade it.
Answer in this format:
Features: <roof, walls, debris>
EMS-98: <Grade 1 to Grade 5>
Priority: <Immediate / High / Standard / Low>
